hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has a separate entry for Wotjobaluk [xwt]. But Wotjobaluk belongs to a large set of named varieties close enough to be the same language which may be called Western Victoria (**hh:hv:BlakeReid:Victorian**). See also: Western Victoria [NOCODE_Western-Victoria].
